# Innovation Competition Workflow

1. Fetch current official notice, track rules, rubric, templates, deadlines, and AI policy.
2. Confirm participant eligibility and select the correct group.
3. Inventory actual assets: prototype, code, data, patents, interviews, pilots, revenue, partners.
4. Build a rubric-to-evidence map.
5. Run problem validation, prototype validation, market sizing, business model, IP, and social impact
   as parallel work packages where their inputs do not conflict.
6. Merge only verified evidence into the project narrative.
7. Create deck, demo script, video outline, and Q&A.
8. Simulate judges using the current rubric.
9. Route unsupported high-value claims back to evidence collection.
10. Freeze artifacts, obtain human approval, and package the submission.

The workflow must distinguish:

- completed and evidenced work;
- completed but weakly evidenced work;
- work in progress;
- plans and forecasts;
- synthetic demonstrations.
